name: @delali/narsil-example-cluster
description: Narsil cluster example: three node processes over TCP with mutual TLS, coordinated by etcd, each serving HTTP.

scripts.certs: narsil-certutil ca --name narsil-example-cluster --out-dir certs --force && narsil-certutil cert --cn node-a --ip 127.0.0.1 --dns localhost --ca-cert certs/ca.crt --ca-key certs/ca.key --out-dir certs --force && narsil-certutil cert --cn node-b --ip 127.0.0.1 --dns localhost --ca-cert certs/ca.crt --ca-key certs/ca.key --out-dir certs --force && narsil-certutil cert --cn node-c --ip 127.0.0.1 --dns localhost --ca-cert certs/ca.crt --ca-key certs/ca.key --out-dir certs --force
